features.description: Cover the read-only curriculum preview lookup by exact program, level, modality, and campus identity.
acceptanceCriteria: The service requests a comparison using the four validated program identity dimensions.
A published reference produces a comparison tied to that reference.
No published reference produces NO_REFERENCE without counts or sample rows.

features.description: Record how local branches and worktrees compare with current develop, and preserve stale or generated files without overwriting the active implementations.
acceptanceCriteria: Feature worktrees were compared with current develop; no missing product delta was identified for transfer.
The legacy coordination-only commit and generated artifacts are excluded from develop.
Legacy worktrees and their local contents remain unchanged.
